classification.difficultyReason: Identify the known coordinate of each marked point and substitute into the equation, solving a linear equation where necessary.

content.prompt: The graph of $3x+2y=12$ is shown opposite. Find the values of $a$, $b$, $c$ and $d$.

spec.description: Ungriddded coordinate axes with no numbered ticks; a falling straight line and four marked points. House graph policy omits the source origin numeral.
spec.mathematics: The line is 3x+2y=12. Marked points are (0,b), (2,c), (a,0) and (d,-2), in descending order along the line.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source-supplied coordinate labels are visible; unknown values remain symbolic.
